title: 第 2154 章 吞吐本源超脱己身天元圣人踏虚空第 2153 章 未至极境仍需锤炼众圣吸收归墟本源之力
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
战场高空，云海层叠之处，一道清瘦沉静的身影静静伫立，不染半点杀伐戾气。
正是冉秋。
他并未参与下方的清缴之战，自始至终静静侍立在孔圣身侧，身姿端正、心神沉敛，全然褪去了往日的青涩稚嫩，周身萦绕着一缕超脱凡俗、温润无瑕的圣道气韵。
赠予诸子百家圣道种子本源，并非贸然之举，亦是他自身悟道的一场天大机缘。此刻的他，正摒弃一切外界喧嚣战事，全身心沉入自身道基神魂，静静消化那枚无上圣道种子的本源底蕴。
此刻，亿万缕看似古朴苍茫的上古圣道韵，实则是幽深诡谲、吞噬万法的黑暗本源，正顺着他的神魂脉络缓缓流淌、层层渗透，悄然改造着他的道基内核，拆解黑暗种子的终极奥秘。
所谓无私共享圣道本源、助百家净化归墟浩劫，从来都不是济世利他。
这枚黑暗种子自带吞噬同化之能，却无法直接吸纳狂暴无序的归墟本源，强行融合只会引发本源崩塌、道途反噬。
于是冉秋刻意伪装善意，将稀释、伪装后的黑暗种子力量分予诸天诸圣，让一众顶尖大能代为出手，净化、打磨、驯服暴戾的归墟碎片。
诸圣以自身圣贤正气淬炼归墟本源、消解凶戾煞气，最终沉淀出的纯粹混沌底蕴，却会顺着黑暗种子的隐秘羁绊，尽数回流、滋养种子本源，等同于诸天百家倾尽底蕴、拼力死战，无偿为他炼化无上修行资粮。
孔圣伫立身侧，一身素衣随风轻扬，眸光深邃如万古苍穹，静静俯瞰着身侧静心悟道的少年，眼底满是欣慰与期许。
他穷尽万古道眼，亦未能勘破这层层完美的伪装，只当冉秋是以身济世、圣道天成，全然被眼前的假象蒙蔽。
他清晰窥见，冉秋的神魂正被看似纯正的先天圣道层层淬炼、节节升华，趋于圆满的亚圣道基稳步蜕变、层层递进，只当对方是借圣道种子普惠诸天的功德积淀，稳步叩问至高境界，却不知这一切蜕变的根基，皆是归墟本源滋养、黑暗大道升华的结果。
“圣道无源，利他自成。”
孔圣轻声慨叹，声线温润悠远，穿透漫天云海战火，“以一己圣种，济百家、安诸天、渡苍生，不求己身速成，先护天下安稳。”
“求，你的功绩，当载史册。”
微风拂过，冉秋眉眼未动，心神全然沉入神魂最深处，看似静心悟道、温润无瑕。
内里翻涌的幽暗本源正疯狂吞吐诸天回流的归墟底蕴，悄无声息完善着这条无人知晓，超脱己身的无上道途。
。。。
同一时间，辽阔苍茫的浩然宇宙深处，天元大陆厚重磅礴的界障之外，混沌气流翻涌沉浮，万古寂寥的虚空之中，一道道威严浩瀚的圣道气息接连铺展、稳稳扎根。
白夜、端木擎苍、陈心瞳、孔方等一众自天关绝境破壁成圣的文人，尽数齐聚于此。

除却这几位新生代绝顶圣人，虚空之中还伫立着十余位年岁悠远、底蕴厚重的老者，皆是天外天留存两千年，将自己封存，熬破寿命桎梏，只为突破寿元枷锁，最终临门一脚突破至圣人境的亚圣们。
而他们也因大道完整，仙脉福泽，灵气复苏等一众原因，突破圣人之境。
新旧圣境强者汇聚一堂，整整二十尊圣人战力凌空列阵，圣道光华交织纵横，万千法理神链缠绕虚空，磅礴浩荡的正气震慑周遭混沌，足以镇锁一方寰宇、荡平十方邪祟。
此番众人跨界集结、齐聚界障之外，目的唯有一个，死守天元大陆域外防线，清剿所有散落虚空的归墟本源碎片，斩杀那些依托碎片孕育成型的仙帝虚影，死死筑牢诸天最后的界域屏障，杜绝浩劫倾覆的可能。
此前数日，一众圣人反复推演战局、商讨对策，细细剖析归墟虚影的杀伐特性、滋生规律与战力短板，敲定了合围清剿、分区镇守、逐片肃清的稳妥战术，规避单打独斗的损耗，以二十尊圣人战力层层联动，最大化肃清域外隐患。
众人刻意休整蓄力、养精蓄锐，待到战术敲定、状态圆满，才不约而同动身，齐聚这片域外战场，准备展开大规模清剿。
除却白夜、端木擎苍二人早已踏足域外虚空、见过宇宙浩瀚之外，其余陈心瞳、孔方等一十八位圣人，在真正凌空踏出天元界障、立身苍茫混沌虚空的那一刻，心底齐齐涌上一股难以言喻的别样情绪，万千感慨翻涌心头，久久难以平复。
在场长辈之中，年岁最轻的孔方，修行岁月也已逼近千载，那些蛰伏天外天、熬破寿元桎梏新晋成圣的老者，更是两千有余。
他们一生扎根天元大陆，生于斯、长于斯、证道于斯，穷尽半生修行求索，皆渴望挣脱天地桎梏，走出这片熟悉的山河故土，奔赴外界广袤浩渺的宇宙天地，探寻更高大道出路、觅得万古修行真谛。
可昔日界障稳固厚重、法理森严，他们未曾成圣之前，修为底蕴不足以撼动天地壁垒，终究被死死禁锢在天元内陆，纵有凌云远志、域外遐思，也只能望界兴叹，无缘得见星河寰宇真容。
今日成圣破限，身负滔天圣道伟力，终于打破亘古界障的禁锢，真正立身域外虚空。
抬眸望去，不再是天元大陆的山川云海、天地穹苍，而是无边混沌铺展四方，浩瀚星河悬空流转，无尽宇宙光影浮沉摇曳，苍茫辽阔、雄浑壮阔，是他们穷尽万古想象也难以描摹的旷世盛景。
立于这片超脱本土的混沌虚空之上，他们也真正见识到了天元大陆完整的宏大图景，心中尘封万古的认知彻底被颠覆。众人透过层层混沌气流、跨越浩瀚星河纵深，清晰窥见了惊天秘辛。
世人毕生立足的天元大陆，从来都不是独立隔绝的一方天地，而是与苍茫混沌界紧紧相连、水乳交融，二者本就是同源一界、不可分割。
天元为有形净土，混沌为无形太虚，一实一虚、一明一暗，宛若天地阴阳两极，相生相辅、互为根基，共同构筑起整片浩然宇宙的完整法理体系，万古以来默默维系着诸天天地的平衡运转。
“原来，这就是我们所在的天元大陆，没想到它竟然是这副模样。”
千年桎梏一朝破除，夙愿今日得偿，岁月沉淀的执念、深埋心底的憧憬，尽数化作汹涌感慨，漫过诸位圣人的心神。
。。。。。。

content_en:
High above the battlefield, where the sea of ​​clouds overlapped, a thin and calm figure stood quietly, without any trace of murderous aura.
It was Ran Qiu.
He did not participate in the battle below. He stood quietly beside Confucius Sheng from beginning to end. His posture was upright and his mind was calm. He had completely lost the youthful youthfulness of the past. There was a ray of transcendent, gentle and flawless aura of the holy way lingering around him.
Giving the disciples the source of the seeds of the holy path of hundreds of schools of thought is not a rash act, but also a great opportunity for him to realize the Tao. At this moment, he was abandoning all the hustle and bustle of the outside world, sinking wholeheartedly into his own Taoist soul, quietly digesting the origin of the supreme holy Tao seed.
At this moment, hundreds of millions of strands of seemingly primitive and boundless ancient holy Dao rhyme are actually the source of darkness that is deep and treacherous, swallowing up all laws. It is slowly flowing along the veins of his soul, infiltrating layer by layer, quietly transforming the core of his Dao foundation, and unraveling the ultimate mystery of the seeds of darkness.
The so-called selfless sharing of the origin of the holy way and helping hundreds of families purify the catastrophe has never been about benefiting the world and benefiting others.
This dark seed has the ability to devour and assimilate it, but it cannot directly absorb the violent and disorderly Guixu origin. Forcible fusion will only cause the origin to collapse and the road to backfire.
So Ran Qiu deliberately pretended to be kind, and distributed the diluted and disguised dark seed power to all the saints in the heavens, and let a group of top powerful men take action on their behalf to purify, polish, and tame the violent Guixu fragments.
The saints use their own sage and righteous energy to temper the origin of the ruins and dispel the evil and evil energy. The pure chaotic essence that is finally precipitated will follow the secret fetters of the dark seeds and flow back to nourish the seed origin. This is equivalent to hundreds of families in the world pouring out their essence and fighting to the death to refine the supreme cultivation materials for him free of charge.
Kong Sheng stood beside him, his plain clothes fluttering in the wind, his eyes as deep as the eternal sky, quietly overlooking the young man beside him who was meditating on enlightenment, his eyes full of relief and expectation.
He had exhausted all eternity of Taoism, but could not detect the layers of perfect disguise. He could only think that Ran Qiu was using his body to help the world, and that the holy Tao was perfected by nature, but he was completely blinded by the illusion in front of him.
He clearly saw that Ran Qiu's soul was being tempered and sublimated step by step by the seemingly pure innate holy way. The sub-sage way base that was approaching perfection was steadily transforming and advancing layer by layer. He only thought that the other party was the accumulation of merits that benefited all the heavens through the seeds of the holy way, and was steadily asking for the highest realm. However, he did not know that the foundation of all these transformations was the result of the nourishment of the origin of the ruins and the sublimation of the dark road.
"The holy way has no origin, and altruism is self-contained."
Kong Sheng sighed softly, his voice was gentle and far-reaching, penetrating the sky full of clouds and seas of war, "With my own holy seed, I will help hundreds of families, bring peace to the heavens, and save the common people. I don't seek quick success for myself, but first protect the stability of the world."
"Please, your achievements should be recorded in the annals of history."
The breeze blew by, but Ran Qiu's eyebrows did not move, and her mind completely sank into the deepest part of her soul, seemingly calm and enlightened, gentle and flawless.
The dark origin surging inside is frantically swallowing up the returned ruins of the heavens, quietly perfecting this supreme path that no one knows about, transcending one's own body.
. . .
At the same time, in the depths of the vast and vast universe, outside the thick and majestic barriers of Tianyuan Continent, chaotic air currents surged and floated. In the eternally lonely void, the majestic and vast aura of the Holy Path spread one after another and took root steadily.
Bai Ye, Duanmu Qingcang, Chen Xintong, Kong Fang and other literati who broke through the desperate situation of Tianguan and became saints all gathered here.
In addition to these top saints of the new generation, there are still more than a dozen old people with long history and profound background standing in the void. They are all sub-sages who have been preserved in the sky for two thousand years. They have sealed themselves and endured the shackles of life span, just to break through the shackles of longevity and finally break through to the realm of saints.
And they also broke through the realm of saints due to many reasons such as the integrity of the avenue, the blessings of the immortal veins, and the revival of spiritual energy.
The powerful men from the old and new holy realms gathered together, and a total of twenty saints were arrayed in the air. The light of the holy path was intertwined, and thousands of legal and divine chains were entangled in the void. The majestic righteousness shocked the surrounding chaos and was enough to suppress it.One side of the world can eliminate evil spirits in ten directions.
This time, everyone gathered across boundaries and gathered outside the boundary barrier with only one purpose: to defend the outer defense line of Tianyuan Continent, to clear out all the fragments of the Guixu origin scattered in the void, to kill the phantoms of the Immortal Emperor that relied on the fragments to form, and to firmly build the last boundary barrier in the heavens to prevent the possibility of a catastrophic overthrow.
In the past few days, a group of saints repeatedly deduced the battle situation and discussed countermeasures. They carefully analyzed the killing characteristics, breeding patterns and combat power shortcomings of the returning ghosts. They finalized the sound tactics of encirclement and suppression, zoned guarding, and clearing out piece by piece to avoid the losses of fighting alone. The fighting strength of the twenty saints was linked up to maximize the elimination of hidden dangers outside the territory.
Everyone deliberately rested and recuperated their strength, and when the tactics were finalized and the situation was perfect, they set off in unison and gathered on this extraterritorial battlefield to prepare for a large-scale cleanup.
Except for Bai Ye and Duanmu Qingcang, who had already set foot in the outer void and seen the vastness of the universe, the other 18 saints, including Chen Xintong and Kong Fang, had an indescribable and different emotion in their hearts at the moment they actually stepped out of the Tianyuan boundary barrier and stood in the vast and chaotic void.
Among the elders present, Kong Fang, the youngest, has been practicing for nearly a thousand years, and those old men who have been dormant in the outer world and have overcome the shackles of longevity and have become saints number more than two thousand years.
They have been rooted in the Tianyuan Continent all their lives, were born here, grew up here, and attained enlightenment here. They have spent half their lives practicing and seeking, all eager to break free from the shackles of heaven and earth, walk out of this familiar land of mountains and rivers, and rush to the vast and vast universe outside to explore a higher way out and find the true meaning of eternal practice.
But in the past, the boundary barriers were solid and thick, and the legal principles were strict. Before they became saints, their cultivation base was not enough to shake the barriers of heaven and earth. They were eventually imprisoned in the Tianyuan inland. Even with their far-reaching aspirations and daydreams outside the territory, they could only look at the world and sigh, and had no chance to see the true face of the galaxy.
Today, I became a saint and broke through the limitations. I was endowed with the mighty power of the holy way. I finally broke through the confinement of the eternal barriers and truly established myself in the void outside the realm.
Looking up, it is no longer the mountains, rivers, clouds, seas, and sky of the Tianyuan Continent, but the boundless chaos spreading in all directions, the vast stars floating in the sky, the endless light and shadow of the universe floating and swaying, the vastness, the majestic grandeur, it is a grand scene that they cannot describe even after exhausting their imagination.
Standing on this chaotic void that transcended their homeland, they truly saw the complete and grand picture of Tianyuan Continent, and the eternal knowledge in their hearts was completely overturned. Through the layers of chaotic air currents and across the depths of the vast galaxy, everyone clearly glimpsed the shocking secret.
The Tianyuan Continent, where people have spent their entire lives, has never been an independent and isolated world. Instead, it is closely connected with the vast world of chaos and blends in seamlessly. The two have the same origin and are inseparable.
Tianyuan is the tangible pure land, and chaos is the intangible emptiness. One solid and one imaginary, one bright and one dark, just like the yin and yang poles of heaven and earth. They complement each other and are the foundation of each other. Together they build a complete legal system of the entire vast universe, which has silently maintained the balanced operation of heaven and earth for eternity.
"It turns out that this is the Tianyuan Continent where we are located. I didn't expect it to look like this."
Thousands of years of shackles were once broken, and the long-cherished wish was fulfilled today. The obsessions accumulated over the years and the longing buried deep in the heart all turned into turbulent emotions that overflowed the hearts of the saints.
. . . . . .
